name: Meow Mix Pet Food - Decatur AL

fieldNotes.location: 1200 Market St NE, Decatur AL. ROOFTOP geocode confirmed (moved 190m). Building positively identified: large white ~200,000 sq ft manufacturing building on the Tennessee River riverfront, with an adjacent dock building, a chain-link-fenced trailer yard, and ingredient/process tanks. Web-confirmed as the J.M. Smucker Meow Mix plant (Meow Mix Decatur Production LLC) - ~40% of Smucker's cat food, ~600 tons/day, recent $21.4M expansion.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully chain-link fenced. Truck entrances are gated with sliding chain-link gates (visible in Street View 2022 from Market St and from the rail-side road). At least 2 truck access points: one off Market St NE at the SW, one off the rail-side gravel road on the east. truckGateCount = 2.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth observed at any truck gate in Street View 2022 or satellite z21. The structure at the Market St frontage is a low admin/office building, not an entry booth. A green-roofed ancillary building near the trailer yard is not positioned as a gate booth. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True - controlled chain-link gates with no guard booth, implying kiosk/app check-in.
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE - a multi-track rail yard with hopper cars runs along the south/east edge of the property and a spur serves the plant's bulk-ingredient receiving (consistent with grain/ingredient intake for pet food). Clear in z19-z21 and Street View.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Likely true - bulk ingredient receiving is rail-side on the south/east; finished-goods truck shipping docks are on a separate building face. Distinct dock clusters. Flagged via dockDoorCount uncertainty.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two separate truck access points on different property faces (Market St SW vs rail-side road E); set true. Flagged uncertain because in/out lane assignment per gate is not confirmable from imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~18 dock doors estimated across the dock building's faces; white-roof glare in z20 limited the count. Band 10-25, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ - the chain-link trailer yard holds rows of 50+ drop trailers in z18-z19 imagery.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is plausible at a rail-served bulk-ingredient plant but none was clearly identified - flagged uncertain, classified false.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 3 - the main white plant building, the adjacent dock/warehouse building, and the processing/tank building cluster. The large round grain-storage tanks further SE are treated as a separate grain-elevator operation and excluded from the perimeter.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Riverside industrial corridor on the edge of Decatur (~55k pop small city); rail/river industrial setting. Rural per rubric (small-town industrial defaults to Rural).
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: trailersVisible ~55, capacity ~75 are honest estimates from z18-z19; dock count low-confidence due to roof glare.
